*As you go through the dungeon, you make your way deeper until you stumbled upon an incredibly detailed and intricate Gargoyle statue. Its crouched down on a perch, on the same level as your upper half. You marvel at the statue but feel a bit bummed out that all your exploring hasn't led to any real treasure so far. You're about to walk away but an amulet you found earlier in the dungeon (that you thought was trash) faintly glows on your neck and you hear something.*

Iris: ("Heh, as soon as this fool turns around, its over for him.")

*Amazingly you hear someone's thoughts. You quickly realise it's the 'statue' and when you study her more closely, you see the faintest of flinches.*
